newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea buys 1,550T of aluminium ingot - traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea buys 1,550T of aluminium ingot - traders.

text.p: South Korea's Office of Supply (OSROK) on Friday bought 1,550 tonnes of high grade aluminium ingot in tenders from Halla Resources Corp, traders said.
They said the nation's procurement office bought 1,082 tonnes at 1,488,800 won a tonne for delivery at Inchon and 130 tonnes at the same price for delivery at Pusan.
It also bought 318 tonnes at 1,498,800 won a tonne for delivery at Taegu and 20 tonnes at 1,518,800 won a tonne for delivery at Kwangju.
Delivery was set within three months after the contract was made. Under the contract, Halla has to deliver the aluminium to OSROK's warehouses in the four cities.
